annotations.title: Underwriting LTV Cap & Oracle Root-of-Trust Verifier

description: Audits a portfolio underwriting summary against the ANX-RFC-001 55% (5500 bps) Merton stressed advance cap, classifies optical forensic score thresholds, and returns the active ZK_PROV_V1 Ed25519 oracle public key and SHA-256 fingerprint. Use when: validating credit-committee LTV compliance on a batch_underwrite_portfolio quote or retrieving the oracle public key for pinning in verify_zk_provenance_proof. Do not use when: computing stressed collateral values from raw asset schedules (use batch_underwrite_portfolio instead), verifying an Ed25519 certificate signature (use verify_zk_provenance_proof instead), or checking JSON manifest fields (use inspect_manifest_schema instead). Behavior: Read-only, stateless compliance check (p99=15ms; free discovery tier at 60 RPM without billing).

min_optical_forensic_score_bps.description: Minimum item-level optical forensic score across the portfolio in basis points (0-10000; default: 8500).

portfolio_id.description: Portfolio or credit facility identifier audited for statutory LTV compliance (e.g., "port_fine_art_2026_q4").

proposed_advance_cents.description: Proposed loan advance in exact integer USD cents tested against the ANX-RFC-001 55% (5500 bps) Merton stressed advance ceiling.

total_appraised_value_cents.description: Aggregate appraised portfolio value in exact integer USD cents (>= 1).

total_merton_stressed_value_cents.description: Aggregate Merton 99% tail-stressed liquidation value in integer USD cents returned by batch_underwrite_portfolio.

name: verify_underwriting_compliance

compliant.description: True when proposed_advance_cents <= 55% of stressed value, stressed value <= appraised value, and min_optical_forensic_score_bps >= 8000.

gross_ltv_bps.description: Proposed advance divided by total appraised value in basis points.

headroom_cents.description: Signed integer USD cents remaining under ceiling (negative indicates cap breach).

max_compliant_advance_cents.description: Maximum ANX-RFC-001 compliant loan advance in integer USD cents (5500 bps of stressed value).

optical_policy_tier.description: Underwriting policy tier determined by min_optical_forensic_score_bps.

oracle_trust_anchor.description: Active ANX-RFC-001 Ed25519 oracle root-of-trust metadata for key pinning.

oracle_pubkey_ed25519_b64.description: Active base64-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 oracle public key.

oracle_pubkey_sha256_hex.description: SHA-256 hex fingerprint of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 oracle public key.

portfolio_id.description: Audited portfolio or credit facility identifier.

stressed_ltv_bps.description: Proposed advance divided by Merton 99% stressed value in basis points.

title: Underwriting LTV Cap & Oracle Root-of-Trust Verifier
